title: Female borrowers who label themselves as deserving candidates for support fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who include a specific note about the accompanying photograph may fund faster.
Female borrowers who include narratives of displacement or civil war in their pitches may fund faster.
Female borrowers who specify loan amount in PHP and mention NWTF may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who explicitly mention a good credit history may fund faster.
Female borrowers who list specific physical items to be purchased may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention food security in their pitches may fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention specific family members and their education may fund faster.
Female borrowers who name a specific organization or town may fund faster.
Female borrowers who specify the number of children may fund faster.
Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
Specifying the number of years a business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention a history of successful loans from NWTF fund faster.
Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
Mentioning existing asset ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
